results.title: SM Energy Data Breach Exposes Personal Information: Murphy Law Firm Investigates Legal Claims
results.description: Murphy Law Firm investigates claims on behalf of everyone whose information was exposed in the SM Energy data breach.

results.title: There are 360 billion tons of coal under federal land, new report says
results.description: The Trump administration created a new report showing how much coal lies under public acres. It’s part of its initiative to reinvigorate the industry.

results.title: Nashville renter got sky-high electric bills, landlord covered some. Metro Codes says AC still wasn't fixed
results.description: A tenant at The Finery in Wedgewood-Houston says repeated maintenance visits never fixed his cooling problem, leading to electric bills topping $300 and a Metro Codes violation.

results.title: Southwest Boulevard streetscape project brings new barriers, restaurants see business rebound
results.description: A new set of concrete barriers installed as part of a road diet near Southwest Boulevard and West 25th Street is creating confusion for some drivers.
